method.description: Historical daily replay of the Early Watch surfaced shortlist using the locked four-batch numerical snapshot and the shared fixed validation calendar.
method.candidateSource: All daily Early Watch Review First candidates from all four designated universe batches.
method.repeatedNames: pickDayObservations reflects what the user would see each confirmed scan day. firstSurfaceEpisodes removes consecutive-day repeats and preserves completed zero-pick sessions as episode breaks.
method.holdout: Training and validation use the repository fixed calendar with outcome-date purging. Historical Final remains closed.
method.coverage: A date is treated as a completed combined-market scan only when all four designated batch reports include it for that horizon. Partial coverage is disclosed and never counted as a zero-pick session.
method.capTest: On days with more than six eligible names, top six are compared with excluded names to test ordering value.
method.rankingTest: Outcome-blind ranking variants change ordering only. Eligibility and max-six policy remain unchanged.
